summary: WHAT'S LEFT? is a project I created to explore the things humanity left behind on the Moon. I wanted to turn these forgotten pieces of space history into something people can actually discover and interact with. So I built a small digital museum using 3D models, Blender and web development, combining my interest in space, technology and creativity. Because there's more to the Moon than just the missions we remember.
details:
WHAT'S LEFT? is an interactive digital museum that explores the objects humanity left behind on the Moon. I came up with this idea because I wanted to look beyond the famous lunar missions and focus on the equipment and scientific instruments that are still part of the Moon's history. Some of these objects might seem forgotten, but each one has a story and a purpose worth discovering.

Through this project, I wanted to make exploring these objects more interesting and accessible. The website brings together a lunar environment, 3D models and visual storytelling, allowing visitors to discover selected artifacts and learn more about their significance. One of the featured objects is the Apollo Lunar Laser Ranging Retroreflector.

I built the experience using HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Blender, while using NASA resources for inspiration and 3D assets. I wanted to combine my interests in space, technology and creativity to create something educational but also enjoyable to explore.
